Forward Deployed Engineer - NYC 
 
Competitive base, uncapped upside tied to what you ship.
 
Working for our client, strategists scope and prioritize the bets.  Forward Deployed Engineers make them real.  You are the engineer who walks into a client codebase and ships the AI workflow that changes how thousands of people do their job.

You work close to the problem and close to the client. Architecture decisions are yours. The code is yours. The credit and the consequences are yours. You partner with Strategists to choose the right bets, with client engineering teams to ship inside their stack, and with the latest agentic coding tools to move at speeds that were not possible a year ago. The bar is production, not demos: what counts is the workflow running on Monday morning when nobody from the company is in the room.

Live engagements, to give a sense of the work:

- Insurance: an agent handling tier-1 claims disputes inside a fifteen-year-old claims platform for a national insurer, cutting resolution time for real  policyholders.

- Healthcare: an AI routing layer designed, prototyped with Claude, and rolled out across a three-hospital health system with the client's own engineers.

- Design agent systems that are reliable, auditable, and keep humans in the loop where they belong.
- Make the team better: workflow refinements from one engagement get adopted across every other engagement, so individual wins compound firm-wide.
 
What you MUST bring:
- 3 to 8 years building and shipping production software end to end, with a track record of turning complex problems into clean, scalable systems.
- AI as a core part of how you work: agentic coding tools raise the quality and throughput of everything you ship.

- Collaborative rigor: high standards for yourself and others, active contribution to team knowledge.
